strings.TOO_MANY_REGIONS_FOR_CONVOY_RAID: {name} can only cover at most {amount} regions efficiently for convoy raiding. Their efficiency is lowered to $EFFICIENCY|%.0H$.
strings.TOO_MANY_REGIONS_FOR_CONVOY_RAID_DETAILE: At lower efficiencies, convoy raiding task forces will have a harder time spotting enemy convoys and will have less ships present at the start of combat.
strings.TOO_MANY_CONVOYS_FOR_CONVOY_ESCORT_DETAI: At lower efficiencies, convoy escort task forces will not be able to fully cover all convoys. If convoys are engaged, less ships will be available at the start of combat to protect them.
strings.TOO_MANY_CONVOYS_FOR_CONVOY_ESCORT_REMED: Adding more ships to the mission will increase Escort Efficiency
strings.TOO_MANY_SHIPS_TO_REPAIR: The Naval Base capacity is too low to repair all ships waiting in queue.
strings.TOO_MANY_SHIPS_TO_REPAIR_NO_DOCKYARDS: You don't have enough dockyards allocated for repairs to use the full capacity of the naval base.
